def: a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor)

occurrences.text: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
